claims.exact_statement: For every restriction-critical nonconstant Boolean K on a finite uniform cube, if some relevant coordinate has a constant physical child, then H(K)/I(K)<=C_*, where C_*=max_{0<=p<=1} c(p) for the exact constant-branch selector tax and 4.872321<C_*<4.872322. Hence any restriction-critical source with H/I>=4.872322 has two nonconstant physical children at every relevant coordinate.
hypotheses: restriction-criticality against every nonconstant physical child

proof_dependencies.scope_used: arbitrary-Boolean-child scalar packet formula versus a constant

refutes: A restriction-critical source of ratio at least 4.872322 can have a relevant coordinate with a constant child
claims.first_unproved_line: Bound the critical step ratio on tensor-prime sources with two nonconstant children at every relevant coordinate.
